title: Grasp selection from a depth image
summary: Candidate grasps on a depth image are ranked by the planarity of the surface patch under each fingertip and by the distance from the grasp to the centroid of the segmented object.

claims.text: A method of selecting a grasp, comprising: for each candidate grasp on a depth image, measuring the planarity of the surface patch under each fingertip; measuring the distance from the grasp to the centroid of the segmented object; and ranking the candidate grasps by planarity and distance.
